title: The first target is the default goal
objective: Order the rules so that a bare make runs the greeting, while make goodbye still runs the farewell.
hint: With no goal on the command line, make runs the first target it sees in the file.

steps.description: make goodbye runs the second rule
the default goal does not run the farewell too

lesson.goal: Understand the difference between default and explicit goals.
lesson.prediction: Which rule will be chosen by naked make and make goodbye respectively?
hints: When there are no command-line targets, make chooses the first target it reads.
When moving the entire rule, the target name and its recipe are moved together.
Let the hello rule appear before goodbye.
lesson.explanation: Naked make only builds the first target; explicitly writing goodbye will select goodbye.
